title: AEGS Budget Envelope
description: One spending constraint, and how much of it remains. AEGS distinguishes two kinds, because conflating them misleads every reader: a **cumulative** envelope accumulates over a window, while a **per-action cap** never accumulates and its 'used' figure is permanently zero. Rendering a cap as a spent budget states the opposite of what it means -- a real defect this project shipped and had to fix.

cumulative.description: False for a per-action cap. When false, `used` carries no meaning and consumers must not display it as consumption.

used.description: Null or ignored when cumulative is false.

scope.description: What the envelope is keyed on -- agent, counterparty, resource, intent.

binding.description: Whether this was the tightest constraint on the decision.
